item.title: The end of 2018
item.description:
In the last day of the year, while writing a summary of the year and update new year plan,I am thinking of the time.

As you get older, the proportion of your life in a lifetime is getting lower and lower, and the year is getting shorter and shorter for you. In fact, it is not that the earth is getting faster and faster, the change is the sensibility that you look at the surroundings and people,and touch the world.
